eventDetail.scope: The conference focuses on advances in agrivoltaics, smart farming, renewable energy, artificial intelligence, machine learning, embedded systems, Internet of Things, robotics, autonomous systems, and industrial automation. It aims to bring together researchers, academicians, industry professionals, entrepreneurs, and students to present innovative technologies and practical solutions for sustainable agriculture, energy-efficient farming, intelligent monitoring, precision agriculture, crop management, environmental protection, and smart rural development.
